title: Wire pattern checks into check::evaluate + surfaces (review, constraints tool, orient)
description:
Dispatch the patterns.rs pass from BOTH check::evaluate arms (evaluate_dd and evaluate_raw) so review, orient, sutra_constraints violations, and guard get it uniformly. EvalScope handling: SingleFile → that file only if scope-matched; changed-files/workspace → all scope-matched files of the constraint's language.

Waiver partition: pattern findings match constraint_waivers on (constraint_id, file_path, symbol_qualified_name) — a symbol-level waiver suppresses matches inside that symbol only; file-level waiver (null symbol) suppresses whole file. Surfaces: sutra_constraints list shows forbidden_pattern with matched_file_count + waiver counts (dead-constraint warning if scope matches nothing); violations action includes pattern findings with line/snippet; review includes them in constraint_violations with severity-based risk contribution; orient constraints_for_component scope-matches them like other scoped kinds.

Review scans changed files only. violations action scans scope-matched files on demand — do NOT build caching in this slice; note timing in execution_record if slow (cache by (file_hash, constraint_id) is the designed follow-up).

Design: sutra/221 implementation_plan. Integration tests in tests/review-test.rs + constraints tool tests.
execution_record: Pattern checks wired into check::evaluate cleanly. Key structural decision: pattern scanning must run BEFORE the early-return-on-empty-edges in both evaluate_dd and evaluate_raw, since patterns are per-file (not edge-based). Both early returns were initially missed, caught by integration tests on first run. Waiver matching updated to support symbol-level granularity for pattern findings — file-level waiver (null symbol) suppresses whole file, symbol-level waiver only suppresses matches inside that symbol. Review compute output was missing line/snippet/enclosing_symbol fields — added to match finding_to_json in constraints tool. orient constraints_for_component already had ForbiddenPattern => true which is correct (scope check at top handles scoped patterns; unscoped patterns apply everywhere). 6 integration tests added covering: evaluate_dd workspace scan, ChangedFiles scope filtering, symbol-level waiver partitioning, review build_findings pattern inclusion, scope-based file filtering, and file-level waiver suppression."

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial): needs-attention → fixed.

[high] RawConn pattern scans dropped waivers for files without import edges (src/constraints/check.rs:595-620). `relevant_paths` was derived only from `path_map` (import edges) + external findings. A SingleFile with no resolved imports but with pattern findings never had its waivers loaded. Fix: resolve SingleFile path early and include in relevant_paths. Regression test: `evaluate_raw_pattern_waiver_on_edgeless_file`.

Fixed in a835d08."

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Review: approve with notes. Wiring correct across both evaluate arms. Waiver semantics change (symbol-level matching) is backwards-compatible. Two bugs (edgeless waiver loading, delta reporting) fixed in a835d08. Minor: constraint_coverage for ForbiddenPattern ignores language when counting scope matches.
